entries.appliesTo: executive office of technology services and security (FY2027 appropriation proviso)

sources.program: item 1790-0100 — 'not less than $250,000 shall be expended to expand the AI For Impact program to design, test and deploy artificial intelligence solutions that improve delivery of state services and build an AI-ready state workforce'

flags: appropriations-only: MA H 5555 is the FY2027 general appropriations act (~1.4MB text); its sole AI provision is a minimum-spend proviso ($250,000) inside line-item 1790-0100 funding the AI For Impact program — no regulatory duties, no compliance obligations on any party, no penalties
not omnibus for rule-9 purposes: only one AI-relevant provision, one family-coherent segment
legiscan relations show this bill 'replaces' H 5501 — H 5555 is the surviving vehicle, so duplicateOf is null
item 1790-0100 also requires an IT consolidation/cybersecurity report to the legislature by February 17, 2027, but that reporting duty is general IT, not AI-specific — not coded
text on file is the Introduced (conference committee report) version per manifest, doc_id 3451620
